title: Build and independently validate strong nonthermal e−e+↔γγ Pauli/Bose mode sources and positive finite-volume time integrator
objective: Full QED 5D weak moments were extended to arbitrary physical nonthermal electron/positron/photon occupations, with conservation/entropy and sign-changing electron/photon bumps. Yet only integrated weak rates exist; no energy/momentum-mode-resolved strong C[f] with positive occupations or time integration. Fix high-T F−R cancellation, then devise on-shell microreversible conservative event-deposition into physical fermion/Bose bins, check finite-bin equilibrium defects, independent weak/strong Q and entropy; implement bounded implicit time solver with dt/cutoff/angular convergence, real charge and finite eγν reservoirs. Add UV/gauge χ1 portal only after plasma validation.
prerequisites: Check actual Scientific CI on nonthermal weak new commit, previous full thermal QED commit 59123b (run #44957890224 was in_progress at earlier check), and prior QED vacuum b8af5e.
Read kinetics/QED-PAIR-NONTHERMAL-WEAK-AUDIT.md and result JSON, retain negative high-T 3.02e−6 F−R cancellation and photon bump ~1.14e−5 nrad shift.
experiments: Design a pairwise conservative event source depositing each e−,e+,γ quartet into individual energy bins while preserving exact charge/energy, nonnegative entropy, electron Pauli 0..1 and photon b>=0; test discretized equilibrium against continuous thermal FD/BE and explicitly quantify any projection bias.

Use nonthermal 5D quantum weak integral as independent reference for every strong species energy/number source; build positivity-preserving implicit reversible 2↔2 finite-volume integrator with dt, grid and event-order error scans.

Then implement realistic photon/electron/positron chemical relaxation with neutrino weak channels, charge-neutral baryons, QED thermal masses, H, and validated gauge-invariant χ1/χ2+φ UV portal and quantum Bose production; no physical 86eV claims until terminal gates.

Derive and implement strong mode-resolved e−e+↔γγ collision, no assuming FD/BE forms: distribute 5D on-shell events to conservative energy/momentum bins without losing exact detailed balance or creating fake heat; independent weak/strong moments, trial perturbed distributions, finite temperature scan.

Evolve finite-volume electron/positron/photon states with positivity/Pauli and photon Bose, exact EM charge, photon number not conserved, full energy and entropy ledgers; determine chemical relaxation including inverse vs actual H, photon reheating and weak ν.

Gauge-invariant finite-T χ1 lepton doublet + singlet portal and UV mediator, checked kinetic χ relaxation/electron heat + real χ1↔χ2+φ Bose production; only then FRW, 86eV freezeout, absolute Omega and observables after full convergence.

Compute true full 5D e− e+ ↔ γ γ QED amplitude with CM boosts of BOTH final photon energies and Fermi/Bose F−R for nonthermal distributions, no counting loss-only R as net Γ; test exact thermal stationarity with μe−=−μe+, μγ=0.

Implement conserved electric charge and total e±γ energy, photon number-changing (not conserved), and entropy in a finite bath; quantify reaction chemical timescales with photon Bose stimulation and electron Pauli, compare to fast/frozen pair limits.

Then include weak ν interactions, evolving photon/e±/ν gstar/entropy, explicit SU2×U1 valid χe/χν mediator and 5D nonlinear χe collision, followed by physical BEST Bose 1↔2, RD/FRW and late freezeout without unfounded 86eV claims.

Implement physical 2↔2 e−+e+ ↔ γ+γ collision with exact on-shell electron mass, spin/polarisation and exchange symmetry factors, Pauli e± and stimulated Bose γ, and test detailed balance/charge/energy/entropy in a finite bath without resetting T.

Compare fast chemical equilibrium versus frozen e+ and e− charges through pair freezeout, bracket actual C_Q with microscopic reaction rates and finite photon/ν heat capacity; include baryon charge and gstar background.

Establish gauge invariant χ1-e,ν UV portal and temperature validity; then full nonthermal χ1/SM Pauli collision, real χ1↔χ2+φ Bose coupling to BEST, FRW convergence, no 86eV claim without terminal gates.
Derive physically correct finite-SM heat at FIXED net charge when μe−(T) adjusts, rather than using naive ∂ρ/∂T|μ=0. Include susceptibility matrix and photon reheating where chemistry is fast.

Implement independent e+e−↔γγ quantum 2↔2 energy/momentum/charge ledger, Pauli for e±, Bose for γ, and a realistic rate to distinguish chemical equilibration/freeze-out; check crossing and units with external source.

Derive gauge-consistent χ portal to electron left/right and neutrinos, validity of point interaction at relevant T, thermal masses, and heat exchanged with neutrino bath and photons; refuse UV-extrapolated Γel.

Independently constrain thermal cutoff by computing both incoming and outgoing cut tails; asymptotic electron Boltzmann suppression at T/me=.1 with finite positron/electron chemical potentials and charge neutrality; preserve nonmonotonic n/cut negative results.

Derive and implement finite-T e−,e+,γ,ν number and energy budgets with e+e−↔γγ and weak ν interactions where applicable, Pauli/Bose and exact Qdark+QSM conservation, independent equilibrium checks, no hidden thermal reset.
Fix explicit SU(2)L×U(1)Y-consistent lepton portal and UV mediator mass/couplings; distinguish e_L,e_R,ν and temperature vs mW, EFT breakdown; compute physical thermal rates and error bounds.

Extend nonlinear Pauli kinetic evolution beyond equilibrium FD temperature perturbations and compare to independent direct 5D kernel with q/h/angular/dt cutoffs; do not claim gamma_el from heat moment alone.

For finite me test energy-cutoff and quadrature 3+ refinements, Pauli at arbitrary independent chemical potentials and Tchi != Te, and finite heat capacity with e+e- annihilation; document EFT breakdown near electroweak restoration.

Run python -m pytest -q tests/test_finite_mass_chie_kernel.py; independently check trace with finite-mass Dirac gamma matrices and CM 5D differential heat against 1D transfer kernel; preserve negative controls.

Check new scientific-ci.yml Python 3.11/3.13 workflow for 832b5b3; if green, record run IDs and then independently validate massive-electron kernel threshold heat versus continuum and cutoff/mesh convergence.

Independently check q-interval convolution normalisation and azimuth-averaged trace by numerical 5D and brute-force azimuth evaluations. Verify forward/reverse K equality to machine precision for many physical shell configurations and full Fermi entropy gain at arbitrary μχ,μe.

Run additional independent 5D Gaussian p,k/angle and 1D ℓ+3D energy collocation convergence at M/T=.1: energy h=.5,.25,.125 and smaller, electron cutoff, χ endpoint and transfer Gauss orders; preserve currently non-monotonic negative case.

Extend exact invariant two-body q-kernel to finite m_e=0.51099895 MeV and relevant e+e− number-changing/chemical freezeout processes, verify m_e→0 and T≪m_e suppression; include physical neutrino left-doublet channels and distinguish eL/eR and ν baths under EWSB.

Derive UV mediator/gauge-complete χ1–SM theory and valid temperature/momentum domain; tabulate actual thermal masses, SM plasma gstarRho(T)/gstarS(T), electron/positron chemistry, finite heat transfer and cosmological H.

With physical rates and finite lepton bath, couple time evolution of nonlinear χ distribution and χ1↔χ2+φ Bose/Pauli in pinned BEST without old phenomenological BGK. Independently verify qmin/qmax/dt/seed and energy/entropy conservation through genuine late freezeout.

Measure actual physical Ω_phi, BEC only if IR zero-mode cutoff stable, then CLASS/linear observables subject to correct perturbation equations and observational constraints; otherwise state falsification scope.
At each completed stage update checkpoint/evidence with quantitative positive and negative results, fast-forward commit+push (never force), begin next research stage inside current run.
acceptance: Direct physically time-reversal paired on-shell kernel, no arbitrary Wpair or BGK; exact nonthermal χ/e particle/energy/entropy and Pauli, independent 5D normalisation
Quantitative h,ℓ,cutoff,dt convergence and error budget; nonmonotone finite-grid case included
Gauge/UV-valid real thermal lepton/e±/ν and finite SM heat, not one ideal massless electron-only sample
Physically evolved χ1+χ2+φ+SM to freezeout with independent BEST/FRW/observational validation before any 86eV relic/ΩDM/BEC/CLASS claim
